name: Ocala World Equestrian Center Breakfast with Santa
venue: Connor's Meeting Room A and B, The Equestrian Manor
when_note: Saturdays, November 28 through December 19, 9 to 11 AM
cost: Adults $75, children ages 6 to 12 $30, ages 5 and under free with an adult ticket
paras: World Equestrian Center Ocala lists a 2026 Breakfast with Santa from 9 to 11 AM in Connor's Meeting Room A and B at The Equestrian Manor. The event page shows November 28 and a photo sign that reads Saturdays through December 23.

The morning runs on a schedule: breakfast with Santa at 9 AM, storytime with Santa at 10 AM, and photos with Santa and gift giving at 10:15 AM. Children get a holiday crafting station, a Christmas letter writing station and a special gift from Santa.

The breakfast spread includes a french toast station, made to order eggs, warm sticky buns and a milk and cookie station. Tickets are $75 for adults, $30 for children ages 6 to 12, and free for ages 5 and under with an adult ticket, plus taxes and online service fees.
tip: Buy tickets ahead, since seating is limited and prices rise 15 percent 72 hours before the event.
